title: Build Organization and Code Quality
learningObjectives: Explain the main ideas of Build Organization and Code Quality.
Identify the language rules and relevant C++ constructs.
Apply the topic in a small program.
Recognize common pitfalls and safety concerns.
Test an example and justify design decisions.

understand.concept: Headers declare interfaces; source files define them and compile as translation units. The linker connects compiled units. Quality includes focused functions, explicit dependencies, warnings and reproducible build steps.
understand.whyItMatters: Organized code is easier to build, review, test and maintain as projects grow.
understand.explain: Separate declarations from definitions, compile all translation units, link them, include what headers require and document warning-enabled build commands.
